description: The planner and reviewer prompts carry no rule about changes that set, overlay or remove environment variables, working directory or git config for a process that spawns children. A flow-engine change of that kind reached main without any child process being listed or run under the new environment, and the resulting regression was only found afterwards.
goal: Add to holon-config/prompts/planner.template.md and holon-config/prompts/review_loop.template.md one rule each: a diff that sets, overlays or removes environment variables, cwd or git config for a process that spawns children must list the child processes affected and carry a test that runs one of them under the new environment. The planner rule makes the plan list those children and the test; the reviewer rule makes the missing list or test a blocking finding. Keep the templates' existing placeholders and structure intact. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: A prompt rule is the earliest point where this class of regression can be caught, before code is written and again at review.
acceptance_criteria: A test in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_prompt_environment_rule.py loads the real holon-config/prompts/planner.template.md and holon-config/prompts/review_loop.template.md and asserts each contains the environment, cwd and git config rule naming the affected child processes and the test that runs one under the new environment.
A test in the same file renders both templates the way the existing prompt template tests do and asserts every placeholder that rendered before the change still renders.
All tests pass via 'uv run pytest' and 'uv run task lint' passes.
